articles.title: MyBank: reset password
articles.text:
How to reset your password in the MyBank mobile app

Before you start, make sure you can access the email address registered with your account.

Open the MyBank app and tap the Profile icon in the bottom right corner. Tap Settings, then choose Security. Tap Reset password. Enter your current password, then type your new password twice. Your new password must be at least 8 characters. Tap Save changes. You will receive a confirmation email within a few minutes.

Warning: Do not share your password with anyone, including bank staff.

articles.title: ShopEasy: track an order
articles.text:
Tracking your ShopEasy order

Open the ShopEasy app and tap the Account tab at the bottom of the screen. Tap My orders. Select the order you want to track. Tap Track package. A map shows where your parcel is and its expected delivery date.

If an order shows "Delayed" for more than three days, contact support from the Help page.

articles.title: StreamBox: cancel membership
articles.text:
Cancelling your StreamBox membership

Sign in to StreamBox on the website. Click your profile picture in the top right corner, then click Account. Under Membership, click Cancel membership. Click Finish cancellation to confirm.

You can keep watching until the end of your current billing period. No refund is given for the remaining days.

articles.title: MailPro: forward email
articles.text:
Forwarding your MailPro email to another address

On the MailPro website, click the gear icon at the top right, then click See all settings. Open the Forwarding tab. Click Add a forwarding address and type the address you want to forward to. Click Next, then Proceed. MailPro sends a confirmation code to that address; enter the code and click Verify.

Note: forwarding only applies to new messages, not to mail already in your inbox.

articles.title: HomeNet router: change Wi-Fi password
articles.text:
Changing your HomeNet Wi-Fi password

Connect a computer to your HomeNet router. Open a web browser and go to 192.168.1.1. Log in with the admin password printed on the sticker under the router. Click Wireless, then click Security. Type your new password in the Passphrase field. Click Apply.

Warning: every device connected to the network will disconnect and must reconnect using the new password.

articles.title: FoodNow: add a delivery address
articles.text:
Adding a new delivery address in FoodNow

Open FoodNow and tap the Profile tab. Tap Addresses, then tap Add new address. Enter the street, building and any delivery notes. Tap Save address. The new address appears in your list and can be chosen at checkout.

articles.title: CloudBox: share a folder
articles.text:
Sharing a folder in CloudBox

In CloudBox on your computer, right-click the folder you want to share and choose Share. Type the email address of the person you want to share with. Open the permission menu and choose Can view or Can edit. Click Send. The other person receives an email with a link to the folder.

articles.title: PayQuick: turn on two-factor authentication
articles.text:
Turning on two-factor authentication in PayQuick

Before you start, have your phone with you.

Open PayQuick and go to Settings. Tap Security, then tap Two-factor authentication. Tap Turn on. Choose Text message as your verification method. Enter the 6-digit code we send to your phone. Tap Done.

From now on, PayQuick asks for a code whenever you sign in on a new device.

articles.title: TravelGo: change booking dates
articles.text:
Changing the dates of a TravelGo booking

Open TravelGo and tap My trips. Select the booking you want to change. Tap Change dates and pick your new check-in and check-out dates. Tap Check price to see any difference in cost. Tap Confirm change.

Some hotels do not allow date changes; in that case the Change dates button does not appear.

articles.title: FitTrack: pair a smartwatch
articles.text:
Pairing a smartwatch with FitTrack

Make sure Bluetooth is turned on on your phone. Open FitTrack and tap the Devices tab. Tap Add device. Choose your watch model from the list. Hold the watch near your phone and tap Pair. When the watch shows a check mark, tap Done.
